above trend dynamic. Structurally
depressed global savings growth is also
a key factor. The trailing 10-year
growth rate of global savings is among
the lowest on record and well below its
long run mean. This dynamic is unlikely
to meaningfully or durably improve given
the ongoing shift to a multipolar world
and all the added fiscal expenditures on

entails. The 15-year high in the 10-year
Eurozone government bond yield, 20-year

30-year high in the 10-year nominal JGB

of global savings continues to
